==Biography==
Diego Vallejo was born in Lima, Peru.

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Zac}}.
* Considered one of the best junglers in Latin America.
* His IGN comes from one of the primary protagonists of the '''[[wikipedia:en:Metal Gear|Metal Gear]]''' video game series.
* Was praised by several casters and analysts from all around the globe for his performance during [[Worlds 2018]].
* He doesn't like jelly.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA All Pro Team (Closing 2021)
* LLA Most Weekly MVPs in his role in the split (Opening 2019)
